items.a: Kagōunga is a creative brand rooted in Ternate, North Maluku. Five distinct forms of expression bound by one identity: gastronomy, personal care, home fragrance, sonic identity, and fine art.

Pantry staples from the North Moluccas: instant Popeda soup, sago starch, sun-dried tuna, turmeric fish seasoning, roasted kenari nuts, butterfly pea flowers, whole nutmeg and mace, and whole cloves - alongside collectible art cards and original brand music.
Our products are made in Ternate, North Maluku, Indonesia, using locally sourced sago, spices, and catch. Food products carry halal certification and P-IRT documentation.
Order via WhatsApp directly from any product page, or find a distribution point near you on the contact page - our stockists span cities from Ternate to Jakarta.
items.q: How do I order Kagōunga products?

items.a: Yes. We partner with retail, cafe, corporate, hotel, distributor, and manufacturing businesses. Wholesale pricing and minimum order quantities appear on each product page where applicable, or contact us to discuss a partnership.

milestones.lede: An overview of Kagōunga's annual journey across exhibitions, music, pop-ups, and collaborative ventures. Upcoming schedules are updated dynamically.

movement.lede: Everything Kagōunga creates grows from four connected movements: innovation, culture, collaboration, and global reach.

partners.lede: A strategic convergence connecting visionary partners who build with us and the media platforms that amplify our journey. Together, these distinct networks form a unified ecosystem driving meaningful impact, innovation, and sustainable growth.

signature.lede: Five distinct forms of expression bound by one identity: gastronomy, personal care, home fragrance, sonic identity, and fine art. Each piece remains deeply rooted in the cultural heritage of North Moluccas.
